popc_atom_name_translation.method: colored molecular graph isomorphism from CHARMM-GUI archived CHARMM27 PSF to the official CHARMM36 GROMACS POPC RTP; source PDB coordinates are unchanged

lipid_template_atom_evidence.hydrogen_policy: Preserve supplied all-atom POPC and SAPI24 coordinates; do not pass -ignh. Protein hydrogens absent from 1H0A are built from CHARMM amino-acid HDB.

reconstruction.paper_composition_deviation: Scaled to 128 total archived POPC molecules due the 100,000 atom cap; additional POPCs were removed near the protein to avoid overlaps. The paper reports 99 POPC plus one PIP2 above and 100 POPC below.
reconstruction.pip2: one CHARMM-GUI SAPI24, P4-protonated, net charge -4
reconstruction.protein_chain: rat epsin ENTH 1H0A chain A, residues modeled 1-158
reconstruction.assumed_h0: chain A residues 1-18; paper-specific residue definition unavailable
reconstruction.placement_assumption: align crystallographic I3P centroid to upper-leaflet phosphate plane; orient protein centroid away from membrane along I3P-to-protein vector; replace nearest upper-leaflet POPC by SAPI24

summary: A reconstructed ENTH/POPC/SAPI24 coordinate set and GROMACS topology were generated. Solvation, MD, and analysis were intentionally skipped by --prepare-only.
artifact_hashes_note: The JSON report's own SHA256 is omitted to avoid a self-referential hash; compute it after the final write.
